dedupe_keys.name: production line component run to failure measurements

description: inIT publishes this production-plant dataset, hosted on Kaggle, for predicting the condition of a component that affects plant operation and product quality. The source identifies eight run-to-failure experiments and eight selected features related to that component. It describes leave-one-out training of self-organizing maps using other components in a new condition, followed by degradation prediction for the component under test. Coverage is the recorded industrial experiments; the plant, component identity, geographic location, calendar period, sampling interval and field definitions are not disclosed in the inspected description. This explicit condition monitoring use qualifies the data while preserving those limits. The linked IMPROVE research and CIRP publication provide related context; their bodies were not retrieved. CC BY-SA 3.0 is stated and reuse charges are not stated. The description reports model observations, but predictive accuracy was not independently established. Internal file format is unknown from the inspected metadata. No measurement or model files were fetched.
